name: Vernal Capital Acquisition Corp. Ordinary Shares
summary: Vernal Capital Acquisition Corp. functions as a special purpose acquisition company, lacking any pre-existing commercial operations. Its core mission is to complete various forms of business combinations, including mergers, amalgamations, share exchanges, asset purchases, equity acquisitions, reorganizations, or other comparable strategic transactions, by uniting with one or more existing enterprises. The entity was established on July 28, 2025, and its main corporate offices are situated in Singapore.
